FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: Not met as written. Guide: 'This guide does not state a waiting period or fee. Confirm current eligibility, timing, fee, and hearing mechanics from the Board's current rules.' Instructions: 'any charge; confirm it with the Connecticut Board of Pardons and Paroles' and 'this packet quotes no unverified number'. The repository holds the answer. The family's own bound source ct-pardon-faq.html.gz (compositionSources, exact; official capture of https://portal.ct.gov/BOPP/Pardon-Division/Pardon/Pardon-FAQs) says: 'The Board of Pardons and Paroles does not currently charge a fee to apply for a pardon. However, you must pay the State Police - now known as the Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection (DESPP) - for processing and providing your State Police Criminal History Report (rap sheet.) ... The Board of Pardons and Paroles does not determine the fee that the State Police charges'. The census requiredSourceId compiled profile CT-connecticut.json says 'Absolute Pardon / COE application $0 BOPP charges no application fee'. Under DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 A1/A2 the named-authority limb is not available when a held source establishes the answer, and neither the amount limb nor the no-fee limb is met. The field map's board_process reason ('no stable application or verified fee is bound') is contradicted by the receipt's own bound FAQ. Tension to flag: CT.memo.json says 'Verify every waiting-period and fee number before it appears in participant-facing copy' and stop 3 says 'no number is quoted'. The bound official Board page is that verification only if the lead accepts it as such.
